items.title: PayPal (PYPL) Stock Gets Fair Value Trim As Analysts Weigh Q2 And Deal Uncertainty
items.summary: Analysts have trimmed their central fair value estimate for PayPal Holdings, with the model price target moving from US$59.16 to US$57.07. The revision comes amid mixed research views, with some analysts highlighting Q2 earnings and asset value, while others focus on competition, questions about a takeover, and recent share moves linked to deal headlines. items.title: Mastercard Gets In on Agentic Payment Systems of the Future
items.summary: Ready for an artificial intelligence bot to buy things for you?  Love it or hate it, the option is getting closer to reality thanks in part to a deal between  Mastercard  and fintech firm Alchemy.  While Mastercard first announced its agentic payment framework back in 2025, the new deal links it to Alchemy’s agent infrastructure, which developers can use to enable their AI agents to buy stuff.
